instruction: Open the provided init.ifc retail shell in Bonsai and use init_plan.png as the plan reference. Convert the shell into a two-level cafe with a mezzanine using native IFC authoring tools, then save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc. The result should keep one project, one site, and one building, and it should have exactly two building storeys named Ground Floor and Mezzanine. Model exactly three spaces named Ground Seating, Counter, and Upper Seating. Include at least two slabs, at least four walls, at least one door, at least two void relationships, and at least one fill relationship. Do not use building element proxies or furniture as substitutes for the required BIM elements. Other details may vary.
